summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five UAE orders reported stuck. Four now COMPLETED per latest comments. One order AE260812-57849665 remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED. Parallel Kibana and DB investigation launched to determine root cause. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two completed UAE orders have clawback processes stuck in RUNNING because Checkout.com declined the clawback authorization. Card declined on re-authorization. Remediation script not yet created — awaits user confirmation on re-trigger approach. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation initiated but RCA not yet completed — only residual EOD generation logs found in the file. Lock file present indicating in-progress investigation. Needs full parallel fan-out to identify root cause and remediation path. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA content found for this ticket — file contains only residual EOD generation logs. Investigation has not been started yet. Needs full investigation workflow to identify the issue, root cause, and appropriate remediation approach. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation initiated but RCA not yet completed — file contains only residual EOD generation logs. Lock file present indicating in-progress investigation. Needs full parallel fan-out to identify root cause and remediation path. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. 11 remediated after SMC team completed device and product mappings. 3 remain stuck — A36 device mapping, identity validation, and product ID mapping. Awaits SMC confirmation before reusing PC-52678. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  Investigation initiated but RCA not yet completed — file contains only residual EOD generation logs rather than actual findings. No root cause identified. Needs full parallel fan-out investigation to determine issue and remediation approach. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  Investigation initiated but RCA not yet completed — file contains only residual EOD generation logs. Lock file present indicating in-progress investigation. Needs full parallel fan-out to identify root cause and determine remediation path. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA daily sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Codebase analysis confirmed both fields exist in type system but were never added to SaSalesReport.groovy. Script modification under PC-53689 prepared. Awaits deployment. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  Refund failure investigation for 18 SA-region orders. Parallel DB queries and Kibana log search launched. Sub-agent requested re-push of auto refund triggers or confirmation for manual refund. Investigation in progress — findings not yet finalized.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
